actions.apply_tag.description: Applies a tag to a subscriber by email, without picking the account from a list.

actions.batch_upsert_subscribers.descrip: Creates or updates up to 1,000 subscribers in one request. Drip processes the batch in the background.
actions.batch_upsert_subscribers.props.a: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.batch_upsert_subscribers.props.s: A JSON array of 1 to 1,000 subscriber objects. Each needs "email" or "id"; other keys use Drip names, e.g. [{"email": "jane@example.com", "first_name": "Jane", "tags": ["Customer"]}].
actions.create_or_update_subscriber.desc: Creates a subscriber or updates the one with this email or ID, without picking the account from a list.
actions.create_or_update_subscriber.disp: Create or Update Subscriber (by Account ID)
actions.create_or_update_subscriber.prop: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.

actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_subscriber.description: Permanently deletes a subscriber and their history. This cannot be undone.

actions.delete_subscriber.props.subscrib: The subscriber email address or Drip subscriber ID.

actions.get_broadcast.props.id.descripti: Single-Email Campaign ID (digits, from List Broadcasts).

actions.get_conversion.description: Gets one conversion goal by ID.
actions.get_conversion.props.accountId.d: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.get_current_user.description: Gets the Drip user who owns the API token.
actions.get_form.description: Gets one opt-in form by ID.
actions.get_form.props.accountId.descrip: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.get_workflow.props.accountId.des: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.

actions.list_broadcasts.props.page.descr: Page number, starting at 1. Pass the next page while Has More is true.

actions.list_campaigns.props.accountId.d: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.list_campaigns.props.page.descri: Page number, starting at 1. Pass the next page while Has More is true.
actions.list_campaigns.props.status.desc: Only campaigns with this status. Defaults to all.
actions.list_conversions.description: Lists conversion goals one page at a time.
actions.list_conversions.props.accountId: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.list_conversions.props.page.desc: Page number, starting at 1. Pass the next page while Has More is true.
actions.list_custom_fields.description: Lists the custom field identifiers used in the Drip account.
actions.list_custom_fields.props.account: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.list_event_actions.description: Lists the custom event action names recorded in the Drip account.
actions.list_event_actions.props.account: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.list_event_actions.props.page.de: Page number, starting at 1. Pass the next page while Has More is true.
actions.list_forms.description: Lists the opt-in forms in the Drip account.
actions.list_forms.props.accountId.descr: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.

actions.list_subscribers.description: Lists subscribers one page at a time, optionally filtered by status, tags or sign-up date.
actions.list_subscribers.props.accountId: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.list_subscribers.props.page.desc: Page number, starting at 1. Pass the next page while Has More is true.
actions.list_subscribers.props.status.de: Which subscribers to return. Drip defaults to Active.
actions.list_subscribers.props.subscribe: Only subscribers created after this date-time (ISO-8601).
Only subscribers created before this date-time (ISO-8601).
actions.list_subscribers.props.tags.desc: Only return subscribers with at least one of these tags.
actions.list_tags.description: Lists every tag used in the Drip account.
actions.list_tags.props.accountId.descri: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.list_workflows.description: Lists workflows one page at a time.
actions.list_workflows.props.accountId.d: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.list_workflows.props.page.descri: Page number, starting at 1. Pass the next page while Has More is true.
actions.list_workflows.props.status.desc: Only workflows with this status. Defaults to all.
actions.record_cart.description: Sends a cart created or updated event to Drip Shopper Activity, e.g. for abandoned-cart workflows.
actions.record_cart.props.accountId.desc: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.record_cart.props.cartUrl.descri: Link back to the shopper cart in your store.
actions.record_cart.props.email.descript: Email of the customer. Either this or Drip Person ID is required.
Status for a person Drip creates from this activity. Drip subscribes them (active) when left empty; choose Unsubscribed if they have not consented to marketing.
actions.record_cart.props.items.descript: Optional JSON array of cart items. Each needs "product_id", "product_variant_id", "name" and "price"; e.g. [{"product_id": "B01", "product_variant_id": "B01", "name": "Water Bottle", "price": 11.16, "quantity": 2}].
actions.record_cart.props.occurredAt.des: When it happened (ISO-8601). Defaults to now.
actions.record_cart.props.personId.descr: Drip subscriber ID of the customer. Used instead of the email when both are given.
actions.record_cart.props.provider.descr: Lower snake_case name of the store platform, e.g. shopify or my_store. Drip treats provider + ID as the unique key.
actions.record_event.description: Records a custom event (such as "Logged in") for a subscriber. Workflows and rules listening for it may run.
actions.record_event.props.accountId.des: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.record_event.props.action.descri: The event name, e.g. Logged in. Reuse names from List Custom Event Names.
actions.record_event.props.occurredAt.de: When the event happened (ISO-8601). Defaults to now.
actions.record_event.props.properties.de: Optional event properties. For a conversion, add "value" in cents.
actions.record_event.props.subscriber.de: The subscriber email address or Drip subscriber ID.
actions.record_order.description: Sends an order event (placed, updated, paid, fulfilled, refunded or canceled) to Drip Shopper Activity.
actions.record_order.props.accountId.des: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.record_order.props.email.descrip: Email of the customer. Either this or Drip Person ID is required.
actions.record_order.props.initialStatus: Status for a person Drip creates from this activity. Drip subscribes them (active) when left empty; choose Unsubscribed if they have not consented to marketing.
actions.record_order.props.items.descrip: Optional JSON array of line items. Each needs "name"; e.g. [{"product_id": "B01", "name": "Water Bottle", "price": 11.16, "quantity": 2}].
actions.record_order.props.occurredAt.de: When it happened (ISO-8601). Defaults to now.
actions.record_order.props.orderId.descr: Your unique internal order ID. Provider + Order ID identify the order.
actions.record_order.props.personId.desc: Drip subscriber ID of the customer. Used instead of the email when both are given.
actions.record_order.props.provider.desc: Lower snake_case name of the store platform, e.g. shopify or my_store. Drip treats provider + ID as the unique key.
For refunded or canceled orders: the amount refunded. Leave Grand Total unchanged.
actions.remove_from_campaign.description: Removes a subscriber from one Email Series Campaign, or from all of them when no campaign ID is given.
actions.remove_from_campaign.props.accou: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.remove_from_campaign.props.campa: Email Series Campaign ID (from List Email Series). Leave empty to remove the subscriber from all email series.
actions.remove_from_campaign.props.subsc: The subscriber email address or Drip subscriber ID.
actions.remove_from_workflow.description: Removes a subscriber from a workflow. Nothing happens if they are not on it.
actions.remove_from_workflow.props.accou: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.remove_from_workflow.props.subsc: The subscriber email address or Drip subscriber ID.
actions.remove_tag.description: Removes a tag from a subscriber.
actions.remove_tag.props.accountId.descr: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.remove_tag.props.subscriber.desc: The subscriber email address or Drip subscriber ID.
actions.start_workflow.description: Starts a subscriber on an active workflow. The workflow may send emails.
actions.start_workflow.props.accountId.d: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.start_workflow.props.customField: Custom field values keyed by field identifier, e.g. {"shirt_size": "Medium"}. A new identifier creates the custom field in Drip.
Email address of the person to start, or the Drip subscriber ID of an existing one.
actions.start_workflow.props.tags.descri: Tags to apply to the subscriber.
actions.start_workflow.props.userId.desc: Your own ID for this person, e.g. the primary key in your database.
Workflow ID (digits, from List Workflows). The workflow must be active.
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.descriptio: Subscribes a contact to an Email Series Campaign by campaign ID, which starts sending that sequence to them.
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.displayNam: Subscribe to Email Series (by Campaign ID)
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.props.acco: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.props.camp: Email Series Campaign ID (digits, from List Email Series).
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.props.cust: Custom field values keyed by field identifier, e.g. {"shirt_size": "Medium"}. A new identifier creates the custom field in Drip.
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.props.doub: Send the double opt-in confirmation email first. Off by default.
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.props.reac: Re-subscribe the contact if they were removed from this series before. When off, Drip rejects such contacts. Drip defaults to on.
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.props.star: Zero-based index of the first email to send. Defaults to 0 (the first email).
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.props.tags: Tags to apply to the subscriber.
actions.subscribe_to_campaign.props.time: The subscriber time zone in Olson format, e.g. America/Los_Angeles.
actions.unsubscribe_subscriber.descripti: Unsubscribes a subscriber from all Drip mailings.
actions.unsubscribe_subscriber.props.acc: Drip account ID (digits, from List Accounts or the Drip URL). Leave empty when the API token has only one account.
actions.unsubscribe_subscriber.props.sub: The subscriber email address or Drip subscriber ID.
Address line 1 of the subscriber's mailing address
actions.upsert_subscriber.props.city.des: The city in which the subscriber resides
The country in which the subscriber resides
actions.upsert_subscriber.props.custom_f: Custom field data about the subscriber
actions.upsert_subscriber.props.state.de: The region in which the subscriber resides
actions.upsert_subscriber.props.zip.desc: Postal code in which the subscriber resides

triggers.subscribed_to_campaign.props.ca: Only trigger for this email series. Leave empty for all.
triggers.subscriber_deleted.description: Triggers when a subscriber is deleted from your Drip account.
triggers.subscriber_unsubscribed.descrip: Triggers when a subscriber unsubscribes from all mailings.
triggers.tag_applied_to_subscribers.desc: Triggers when a tag is applied.
triggers.tag_applied_to_subscribers.prop: Only trigger for this tag (not case-sensitive). Leave empty for every tag.
